Class ConfigValidation

java.lang.Object
com.cuseto.pong.config.validation.ConfigValidation
public final class ConfigValidation extends Object
Validation helpers shared by the configuration schema's compact constructors, used to reject invalid values with a consistent, descriptive message.

      public static void requirePositive(String name, int value)
      Verifies that value is strictly greater than zero.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the value, used in the exception message
      value - the value to check
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if value is not greater than zero

      public static void requireFinite(String name, double value)

      public static void requirePositiveFinite(String name, double value)

      public static <T> T requireNonNull(String name, T value)
      Verifies that value is not null.
      Type Parameters:
